  token_ttl=30m token_max_ttl=60m secret_id_ttl=60m \

- ROLE_ID=$(vault read -field=role_id auth/approle/role/quantum-test-harness/role-id)
- SECRET_ID=$(vault write -f -field=secret_id auth/approle/role/quantum-test-harness/secret-id)

7) Authenticate and obtain a client token
- vault login -method=approle -role-id="$ROLE_ID" -secret-id="$SECRET_ID"
- CLIENT_TOKEN=$(vault print -field=auth.client_token)

8) Read the actual secret (the token used by tests)
- TEST_TOKEN_VALUE=$(vault kv get -field=token secret/quantum/fluc/token)

- vault token revoke "$CLIENT_TOKEN"  (if you created a long-lived token)
- vault kv delete secret/quantum/fluc/token
